name: goomy
flavor: Goomy hides away in the shade of trees, where it's nice and humid. If the slime coating its body dries out, the Pokémon instantly becomes lethargic.

abilities.name: sap-sipper
abilities.effect: Absorbs Grass moves, raising Attack one stage.

abilities.name: hydration
abilities.effect: Cures any major status ailment after each turn during rain.

abilities.name: gooey
abilities.effect: Lowers attacking Pokémon's Speed by one stage on contact.
